integrity: The exact proof rests on Jacobi triple product and Poisson summation. 85 numerical cross-check assertions are supplemental only. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to symmetric three-point configurations for the periodic heat covariance. Classical theta-function comparison literature could contain an equivalent result; no absolute priority claim is made. Numerical verification is finite and is not the proof.
title: A unique conditional-independence angle for three periodic heat-kernel samples
